svg.title: web-01 Kitchen board (Admin Panel, board mode)
svg.desc: Low-fidelity kitchen board for Market Hall at 12:21:05 with the live indicator, a delay block banner for the late order MH-0134, open orders sorted with the late one first, employee tint and initials, a dotted dine-in row, Without and Extra columns, first names only, Ready buttons, an order locked on a till, and the Ready list. Numbered callouts 1 to 10.

g.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Delay block: 2 min (MH-0134 late +2) - kitchen minutes 12:33 and 12:34 held back
No contact data on this board. Status is never shown by color alone.
